parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(stage, 'start') AS stage,
       COALESCE(draft, '{}'::jsonb) AS draft,
       COALESCE(revision, 0) AS revision
FROM (SELECT $1::text AS sender_id) AS input
LEFT JOIN sessions USING (sender_id);

INSERT INTO sessions (sender_id, stage, draft, revision)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4)
ON CONFLICT (sender_id) DO UPDATE SET
  stage = EXCLUDED.stage,
  draft = EXCLUDED.draft,
  revision = EXCLUDED.revision,
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING stage, draft, revision, $5::text AS response;
